summary_1line: Bhishma explains the spiritual merits of digging water tanks, planting trees, and giving compassionate gifts, emphasizing generosity and support of the virtuous.

image_candidates.scene_text: A newly dug tank gleams with water while cows, birds, and travelers gather along its banks to drink under the sun.
A man plants young trees beside a tank and tends them like children while travelers rest in the shade of older flowering trees.
A weary, emaciated scholar is offered food and water by a generous householder at the doorway of his home.
